system.description:
You gain a rank of Mastery to Survival. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a Bruised creature. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead they gain the Severed condition.
